label: Light Half Canvas
description: Light half canvas uses a reduced-weight horsehair canvas from shoulder to mid-chest, offering noticeably more drape and softness than standard half canvas while still preserving a clean chest architecture and a lapel with genuine roll. It is the preferred construction for medium-weight fabrics in warmer climates, threading the needle between structured formality and easy wearability. The jacket breaks in gracefully and moulds gently to the torso over time without the full conforming memory of a true full-floating canvas.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
